subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Traditional Japanese pottery was characterized by hand-thrown forms and natural ash glazes applied during wood-fired kilns.
• These ceramics were used primarily for tea ceremony and daily household purposes throughout rural Japan.
• Contemporary ceramic artists in Japan use a mix of modern and traditional techniques to create pottery inspired by historical styles.
• Most of the techniques used are traditional.
• Artists still hand-throw clay on wheels and apply natural ash glazes using the same methods employed by historical potters.
prompt: The student wants to make a generalization about the techniques used in contemporary Japanese pottery. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Traditional techniques that were used by historical Japanese potters, such as hand-throwing clay and applying natural ash glazes, are still used by contemporary artists.
choices.B: Although most techniques used in contemporary Japanese pottery are traditional, some modern techniques are used.
choices.C: Traditional Japanese pottery was characterized by hand-thrown forms and was used primarily for tea ceremony and daily household purposes.
choices.D: Contemporary ceramic artists in Japan create pottery inspired by historical styles, which featured hand-thrown forms and natural ash glazes.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The sentence makes a generalization about the techniques used in contemporary Japanese pottery, noting that while some modern techniques are used, most of the techniques are traditional.
